snippets.summary: Peter Steinberger (steipete on X) shared 1 recent update. Two months ago, we started the mission to “build OpenClaw with OpenClaw,” and bit by bit, we moved everyone from using their local coding harness to using - our shared agent that knows what everyone’s working on and orchestrates it all. Multiplayer coding + infinite compute with nodes and cloud sessions has been a game changer for how we build. Local harnesses feel like relics of the past now.
